genesisBinding.reason: docs/BACKEND_GAPS.md and the 2026-09-26 managed-genesis reset show managed program addresses can be reused across a genesis swap. B3 requires every record and cache to bind to the network's genesis identity; the history service already has a chain-identity gate (offline fingerprint + live genesis check) that will be reused or lifted into a shared helper when the registry is built (build-order step 3). A changed identity must invalidate records, caches and prepared intents with reason NETWORK_RESET.
